$comment: Written by `procedures:write`; held by its drift test. Do not edit by hand.

accept.keyShape: a set key is 16 to 256 URL-safe base64 characters

accept.codeOnlyWhenRefused: a refused registration names its refusal code; a sent or failed one names none

accept.atMostThree: at most one target per out-of-app channel, so at most three

accept.noCodeWhenVerified: a verified address carries no refusal code, and a code is never empty
